verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for WorkOS, since it ships SDKs, a CLI migrations tool and a hosted dashboard. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any way to disable them. Audit logs and Vault concern customer data features, not opting out of the vendor's own tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
